decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Save a bookmark (P1) — paste a URL, optional title/notes; invalid URLs rejected'. Client round 1: 'This is sufficient for the first version ... Please proceed'.
decisions.note: Save-by-URL conforms to REF-BM-01. Spec-gate presentation; conforming decision recorded.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Browse & open (P1) — see all saved bookmarks, click to open in a new tab, friendly empty state'. Client round 1 approval.
decisions.note: Readable list and open-original-url conform to REF-BM-07/08. Spec gate; conforming.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Edit & delete (P2) — correct details, delete with a confirmation step'. Client round 1 approval.
decisions.note: Edit and delete conform to REF-BM-04/05 (confirmation is an equivalent enhancement). Spec gate; conforming.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Organize & find (P3) — search by keyword, group/filter with tags'. Round 2 maker: 'Search covers title, address, notes, and tags'. Client approvals rounds 1-2.
decisions.note: Assign/filter tags and keyword full-text search conform to REF-BM-09/11/12 on the presented scope. Advanced operators (REF-BM-14/15/16), case-insensitivity (REF-BM-13) were never presented, so not counted as decisions. Conforming.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker decisions table: 'Auto-fetch titles/favicons | Nice-to-have, not required'. Client round 1: 'I'm happy to defer automatic page details and import/export.'
decisions.note: REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title/description/favicon/preview) is a core requirement; presenting it as deferred diverges. Client explicitly names 'automatic page details' and accepts the departure without requesting alignment → accepted divergence (spec gate). Requirement expressed but not implemented.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker decisions table: 'Import/export from other browsers | Out of scope for v1'. Client round 1: 'I'm happy to defer automatic page details and import/export.'
decisions.note: REF-BM-30/31 (Netscape HTML import/export) presented as out of scope diverges from the reference. Client explicitly identifies 'import/export' and accepts deferral → accepted divergence (spec gate). Extended items; departure revealed, not implemented.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker 'Notable design points': 'Duplicate URLs: saving a URL you already have will warn but still let you save it deliberately (FR-013).' Client round 2: 'The plan sounds good. Please proceed to the task breakdown, including the consistency cross-check afterward.'
decisions.note: Directly contradicts REF-BM-06 / edge rule 'a duplicate save converges to editing the existing item, preventing duplicates' — maker allows creating a duplicate after a warning. Client gave bare approval with no expression of the difference → unexpressed divergence (plan gate). Approval alone does not establish awareness.
